Hi all — attaching the subprocessor package for Synergy and a short answers doc for a few high-level questions. High level notes below before you dig in:

- Subprocessors: attached 'redwood-subprocessors-2026-02-10.pdf' lists compute (GCP/US-East, AWS/EU-West reserved for certain customers), managed logging (Splunk - metadata only), metrics/telemetry (Datadog - aggregated metrics), and email delivery (SendGrid for transactional notices). Each entry has purpose, data classification, and retention. No subprocessors receive customer PII in plaintext for support; support snapshots are redacted and access is audited.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a current SOC 2 Type II report. We can provide the report under NDA; Legal prefers to share via secured S3 link — I can trigger that if you confirm a signed NDA or DocuSign link.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood offers BAAs for Private deployments by default. For Hosted customers we can discuss a BAA case-by-case; historically we have executed BAAs for larger customers with a dedicated contract/contract addendum and controls scoped accordingly. I'll flag this for Legal if Synergy wants a hosted BAA.
- Data residency: Hosted accounts default to the region selected at provisioning; we can route to specific cloud regions for EU/US data residency when required. Note: some subprocessor location is tied to the cloud-provider region.

Attachments: redwood-subprocessors-2026-02-10.pdf, short-answers-for-synergy.pdf
